//: Used ONLY by the validation harness (tier2-typecheck) to type-check the TS pairs in strict mode; tsx runs them WITHOUT type-checking. `moduleDetection: force` is essential: the .ts files are standalone scripts with no import/export, so without it they'd share one global scope in a single program and collide (duplicate 'Shape', 'shapes', ...). 'force' gives each file its own module scope, so each is checked in isolation.
